caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet consisting of two main sections: an upper display case and a lower storage compartment, rendered predominantly in shades of brown, blue, and muted yellow. The top section of the cabinet features two glass-paned doors outlined in blue with first panel cut-outs along the top edge, and is decorated with four circular rosettes, two on each door. The interior of the upper cabinet is divided into four panes per door by cream-colored muntins. The lower section has two drawers at the top, each framed in blue with two smaller rosettes and golden oval pulls centered on each drawer. Below the drawers, there are two cabinet doors, each bordered by a blue line, and decorated with a painted angel figure dressed in yellow and blue, framed by a blue rectangular border. Between the upper and lower cabinets, on the drawer separator, there is a strip of white bearing red and brown decorative text and numerals reading "1829." The cabinet stands on four curved legs painted in dark blue-green, and the edges of the cabinet are also outlined in the same blue-green color. The overall style exhibits geometric patterns and folk-art motifs. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, focusing attention entirely on the cabinet itself.
title: Painted Cabinet
